verdict.rationale: Agent Studio lets teams view, manage and edit knowledge data such as Help Center content, FAQs and policies that ground the agent, and Insights shows which knowledge sources informed each answer. Ghostwriter turns uploaded SOPs and raw transcripts into customer journeys rather than ingesting them as a knowledge base. missing for 10: evidence of ingesting past tickets and internal wikis as knowledge, documented connectors or automatic sync for help centers and docs without re-authoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.
